Kennesaw State admissions is somewhat selective with an acceptance rate of 69%. Students that get into Kennesaw State have an average SAT score between 1020-1220 or an average ACT score of 19-25. The regular admissions application deadline for Kennesaw State is July 1. Interested students can apply for early action, and the Kennesaw State early action deadline is November 3.
